intro.t: Part 3 is a conversation, not two speeches. Start it, react to your partner, add to their ideas, move on, and then decide together. Eight frames, in the order you'll need them.

close.t: Brilliant. Start, discuss, decide. And remember: your partner is on your side.

minute.title: Now a whole discussion.
crib: Shall we start with…? I think it's really useful, because…
In my opinion, it's important because…
What do you think? Do you agree?

parts.t: Shall we start with eating meals together? I think it's really useful, because it's the only time everyone is in the same room.
Yes, but lots of families eat in front of the TV.
That's a good point, but even then, you're still together. What do you think about going on holiday?
Holidays are great, but they're really expensive.
Yes, and another thing is that they only happen once a year. Shall we move on to playing games at home?
I love that one. It's cheap, and everyone can play.
In my opinion, playing games is important because it makes people laugh together. I'd probably go for that one, because you can do it every week.
I agree. Games night every Friday!
So, are we agreed on playing games at home?

minute.q: Now, talk to each other about how enjoyable these ways of spending time together are for teenagers.
minute.scene: How enjoyable are these ways for teenagers to spend time with their families? · eating meals together · going on holiday · playing games at home · doing sport together · visiting grandparents

reels.p: Shall we start with …? I think it's really useful, because …
reels.bt: Shall we start with…? I think it's really useful, because…
reels.note: Be the one who starts: name an option and give a reason straight away.

ex.q: Now, talk to each other about how useful these things are for teenagers.
ex.scene: How useful are these for teenagers? · learning online · keeping in touch with friends · finding information · being creative · staying healthy
ex.t: {Shall we start with} learning online? {I think it's really useful, because} you can study at your own speed.

ex.q: Now, talk to each other about how good these ideas are for teenagers who want to earn money.
ex.scene: How good are these ideas for teenagers who want to earn money? · working in a café · babysitting · selling things online · helping in a family business · giving lessons to younger children
ex.t: {Shall we start with} babysitting? {I think it's really useful, because} parents always need help.

ex.q: Now, talk to each other about how effective these ideas would be in helping students to be healthier.
ex.scene: How effective would these ideas be in helping students to be healthier? · healthier school meals · more PE lessons · an after-school sports club · lessons about mental health · banning fizzy drinks
ex.t: {Shall we start with} healthier school meals? {I think it's really useful, because} everyone eats lunch at school.

reels.p: In my opinion, … is important because …
reels.bt: In my opinion, it's important because…
reels.note: Never an opinion on its own: always add "because".

ex.q: Now, talk to each other about how helpful these ideas might be when preparing for exams.
ex.scene: How helpful might these be when preparing for exams? · studying with friends · getting a tutor · using apps and videos · making a study timetable · getting enough sleep
ex.t: {In my opinion,} getting enough sleep {is important because} a tired brain can't remember anything.

ex.q: Now, talk to each other about how much difference young people can make by doing these things.
ex.scene: How much difference can young people make by doing these things? · recycling at home · using public transport · buying fewer clothes · joining a beach clean-up · eating less meat
ex.t: {In my opinion,} using public transport {is important because} cars cause so much pollution.

ex.q: Now, talk to each other about how useful these things are for teenagers.
ex.scene: How useful are these for teenagers? · learning online · keeping in touch with friends · finding information · being creative · staying healthy
ex.t: {In my opinion,} staying healthy {is important because} we spend hours in front of screens.

reels.p: What do you think? / Do you agree?
reels.bt: What do you think? Do you agree?
reels.note: Say your idea first, then ask. Part 3 is marked on talking WITH your partner.

ex.q: Now, talk to each other about how good these ideas are for teenagers who want to earn money.
ex.scene: How good are these ideas for teenagers who want to earn money? · working in a café · babysitting · selling things online · helping in a family business · giving lessons to younger children
ex.t: Selling things online sounds easy, but it takes a lot of time. {What do you think?}

ex.q: Now, talk to each other about how effective these ideas would be in helping students to be healthier.
ex.scene: How effective would these ideas be in helping students to be healthier? · healthier school meals · more PE lessons · an after-school sports club · lessons about mental health · banning fizzy drinks
ex.t: More PE lessons would help, but some students hate sport. {Do you agree?}

ex.q: Now, talk to each other about how helpful these ideas might be when preparing for exams.
ex.scene: How helpful might these be when preparing for exams? · studying with friends · getting a tutor · using apps and videos · making a study timetable · getting enough sleep
ex.t: A tutor is great, but it's expensive. {What do you think?}

reels.note: Kind to your partner, and you still keep your own view.

ex.q: I think a study timetable is a waste of time.
ex.t: {That's a good point, but} it helps you see how much time you really have.

ex.q: Recycling at home is the most useful thing here.
ex.t: {That's a good point, but} it doesn't change what we buy.

ex.q: Working in a café is the best summer job.
ex.t: {That's a good point, but} the hours can be really long.

reels.note: Take your partner's idea and add to it.

ex.q: Being creative online can be really useful.
ex.t: {Yes, and another thing is} that you can share your work with people all over the world.

ex.q: A sports club after school would be fun.
ex.t: {Yes, and another thing is} that students would make new friends.

ex.q: Joining a beach clean-up is a great idea.
ex.t: {Yes, and another thing is} that it shows everyone the problem with plastic.

reels.note: Don't stay on one option for too long. Five options, two minutes.

ex.q: Now, talk to each other about how useful these things are for teenagers.
ex.scene: You've talked about learning online. — How useful are these for teenagers? · learning online · keeping in touch with friends · finding information · being creative · staying healthy
ex.t: {Shall we move on to} finding information? We haven't talked about that one yet.

ex.q: Now, talk to each other about how much difference young people can make by doing these things.
ex.scene: You've talked about recycling. — How much difference can young people make by doing these things? · recycling at home · using public transport · buying fewer clothes · joining a beach clean-up · eating less meat
ex.t: {Shall we move on to} eating less meat? I think that one's quite difficult.

ex.q: Now, talk to each other about how good these ideas are for teenagers who want to earn money.
ex.scene: You've talked about babysitting. — How good are these ideas for teenagers who want to earn money? · working in a café · babysitting · selling things online · helping in a family business · giving lessons to younger children
ex.t: {Shall we move on to} helping in a family business? It could be really useful experience.

reels.note: "Probably" leaves the door open for your partner.

ex.q: Thank you. Now you have about a minute to decide which one is the most useful for teenagers.
ex.scene: How useful are these for teenagers? · learning online · keeping in touch with friends · finding information · being creative · staying healthy
ex.t: {I'd probably go for} keeping in touch with friends, {because} it's what we use technology for most.

ex.q: Thank you. Now you have about a minute to decide which one would be the most helpful.
ex.scene: How helpful might these be when preparing for exams? · studying with friends · getting a tutor · using apps and videos · making a study timetable · getting enough sleep
ex.t: {I'd probably go for} getting enough sleep, {because} without it nothing else works.

ex.q: Thank you. Now you have about a minute to decide which one the school should do first.
ex.scene: How effective would these ideas be in helping students to be healthier? · healthier school meals · more PE lessons · an after-school sports club · lessons about mental health · banning fizzy drinks
ex.t: {I'd probably go for} the sports club, {because} it's fun and nobody is forced to do it.

reels.note: The perfect last line of Part 3.

ex.q: I think healthier meals would help the most.
ex.t: Me too. {So, are we agreed on} healthier meals?

ex.q: Giving lessons to younger children pays really well.
ex.t: That's true. {So, are we agreed on} giving lessons?

ex.q: Eating less meat makes the biggest difference, I think.
ex.t: I think so too. {So, are we agreed on} eating less meat?
